def transform(grid):
    g = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(g), len(g[0])
    # Find rectangular frames by their complete, single-color perimeter.
    frames = []
    for color in range(1, 10):
        pts = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c] == color]
        if not pts:
            continue
        r0, r1 = min(r for r, c in pts), max(r for r, c in pts)
        c0, c1 = min(c for r, c in pts), max(c for r, c in pts)
        if r1-r0 < 2 or c1-c0 < 2:
            continue
        perimeter = {(r,c) for r in range(r0,r1+1) for c in range(c0,c1+1)
                     if r in (r0,r1) or c in (c0,c1)}
        if not all(g[r][c] == color for r,c in perimeter):
            continue
        # Require that all cells of this color belong to this frame.
        interior = [(r,c) for r in range(r0+1,r1) for c in range(c0+1,c1)]
        frames.append((color,r0,r1,c0,c1,interior))
    # A patterned frame is the template; all other rectangular frames are targets.
    sources = [f for f in frames if any(g[r][c] != 0 for r,c in f[5])]
    if not sources:
        return g
    src = sources[0]
    mask = [[g[r][c] != 0 for c in range(src[3]+1,src[4])]
            for r in range(src[1]+1,src[2])]
    # Ignore blank padding inside the source frame when measuring its design.
    occupied = [(i,j) for i,row in enumerate(mask) for j,v in enumerate(row) if v]
    if not occupied:
        return g
    ih = max(i for i,j in occupied) + 1
    iw = max(j for i,j in occupied) + 1
    mask = [row[:iw] for row in mask[:ih]]
    sh, sw = ih, iw
    for f in frames:
        if f is src:
            continue
        color,r0,r1,c0,c1,interior = f
        th, tw = r1-r0-1, c1-c0-1
        # Only matching-sized empty frames receive the source pattern.
        # Other patterned frames and differently sized frames stay unchanged.
        if (th,tw) == (sh,sw) and not any(g[r][c] != 0 for r,c in interior):
            for r in range(r0,r1+1):
                for c in range(c0,c1+1):
                    if r in (r0,r1) or c in (c0,c1):
                        continue
                    g[r][c] = color if mask[r-(r0+1)][c-(c0+1)] else 0
    return g

def transform(grid):
    g = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(g), len(g[0])
    # Find rectangular frames by their complete, single-color perimeter.
    frames = []
    for color in range(1, 10):
        pts = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c] == color]
        if not pts:
            continue
        r0, r1 = min(r for r, c in pts), max(r for r, c in pts)
        c0, c1 = min(c for r, c in pts), max(c for r, c in pts)
        if r1-r0 < 2 or c1-c0 < 2:
            continue
        perimeter = {(r,c) for r in range(r0,r1+1) for c in range(c0,c1+1)
                     if r in (r0,r1) or c in (c0,c1)}
        if not all(g[r][c] == color for r,c in perimeter):
            continue
        # Require that all cells of this color belong to this frame.
        interior = [(r,c) for r in range(r0+1,r1) for c in range(c0+1,c1)]
        frames.append((color,r0,r1,c0,c1,interior))
    # A patterned frame is the template; all other rectangular frames are targets.
    sources = [f for f in frames if any(g[r][c] != 0 for r,c in f[5])]
    if not sources:
        return g
    src = sources[0]
    mask = [[g[r][c] != 0 for c in range(src[3]+1,src[4])]
            for r in range(src[1]+1,src[2])]
    # The source pattern may have blank padding at its bottom or right edge.
    occupied = [(i,j) for i,row in enumerate(mask) for j,v in enumerate(row) if v]
    if not occupied:
        return g
    sh = max(i for i,j in occupied) + 1
    sw = max(j for i,j in occupied) + 1
    mask = [row[:sw] for row in mask[:sh]]
    for f in frames:
        if f is src:
            continue
        color,r0,r1,c0,c1,interior = f
        th, tw = r1-r0-1, c1-c0-1
        # Add the source pattern to blank frames that can contain it.
        if not any(g[r][c] != 0 for r,c in interior) and th <= sh and tw <= sw:
            for i in range(th):
                for j in range(tw):
                    g[r0+1+i][c0+1+j] = color if mask[i][j] else 0
    return g
